title: Operations to transform N samples, directly and by the fast Fourier transform
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale, computed for this frame. For 1,024 samples, the direct calculation takes N², 1,048,576 operations; the fast Fourier transform, by Cooley and Tukey's bound of 2N log₂ N, 20,480. For 8,192 samples: 67,108,864 against 212,992. For 1,048,576 samples: about 1.1 trillion against about 42 million.
heading: OPERATIONS · N² AGAINST 2N LOG₂ N · LOG SCALE
